purpose: Make mem-graph use scoped, inspectable, evidence-governed, and portable across agent hosts.

profiles.discovery_rule: Agents must determine or use the active profile/tool surface. Tool availability does not establish applicability or authority. Never request a tool absent from the active profile.

agent.description: Everyday workflow profile exposing ten typed tools

full.description: Compatibility profile retaining the 41 legacy tools

maintenance.description: Specialist administrative, diagnostic, and SQL operations outside the agent profile

scope.rule: Cross-project availability never implies applicability. Global scope must be explicitly required and reported. Never hydrate foreign projects through scoped retrieval stubs.

bootstrap.when_unconfigured: Omit canonical_ids, use narrow routing terms in an exact-project bootstrap query to discover governing candidates, and directly verify any candidate tracker, scope boundary, or role record before use. Never copy memory IDs from bundled examples. FTS5 searches use AND semantics by default, so a broad compound query can miss stored direction.

recovery_unsupported_compact.rule: If response_mode='compact' is rejected as unsupported, retry exactly once without response_mode='compact'. Never repeatedly retry compact mode.

bootstrap.fallback_constraints: If bootstrap itself is unavailable, select fallback tools strictly from the active profile. Never call hidden legacy tools (e.g. memory_get, cognitive_policy_lookup, cognitive_current_guidance_search) from the agent profile.

agent: directly fetch configured canonical IDs with memory_read:get, or discover scoped contextual candidates using memory_find:search in exact project scope (memory_find:search discovers scoped contextual candidates; it does not create a governing lane or establish authority)
directly fetch applicable candidates with memory_read:get and verify authority from an operator-adopted artifact, canonical role, or explicit delegation
if authority cannot be established, report current guidance unresolved
read the roadmap and active contracts named by the tracker before changing implementation
full: resolve canonical tracker, scope-boundary, and optional role IDs from operator or project configuration; otherwise discover candidates through exact-project governing guidance
read the roadmap and active contract named by the tracker
cognitive_current_guidance_search or cognitive_current_guidance_diagnose in exact project scope
memory_get every selected record before relying on it

fallback: resolve canonical tracker, scope-boundary, and optional role IDs from operator or project configuration; otherwise discover candidates through exact-project governing guidance
read the roadmap and active contract named by the tracker
cognitive_current_guidance_search or cognitive_current_guidance_diagnose in exact project scope
memory_get every selected record before relying on it

retrieval_and_expansion.no_foreign_hydration: Never hydrate a foreign-project source through a scoped expansion. Foreign wikilinks remain bounded reference stubs.
retrieval_and_expansion.no_silent_substitution: Do not silently substitute another tool when a route is unavailable; report the unresolved source or unavailable route honestly.
retrieval_and_expansion.access_tracking_honesty: Expansion operations may touch access tracking (e.g. memory_read:get touches the record; memory_find:related touches returned memories and synapses). Do not portray expansion as zero-touch.

pd_06_cross_call_version_comparison.description: Public compact bootstrap has no trusted cross-call comparison input.
rules: Public MCP cognitive_agent_bootstrap provides no trusted cross-call comparison input.
Preserve verified evidence that is available.
Report cross-call version comparison as unavailable when that fact matters.
Leave future comparison-seam design outside Phase 4B.

mutation.epistemic_boundaries: Epistemic admission (epistemic_admit) and epistemic receipts (epistemic_append_receipt) remain separate authority and effect boundaries.
mutation.event_boundaries: Cognitive event append (cognitive_event_append) and event read (cognitive_event_read) remain separate routes.

required_order: append immutable evidence or decision event with stable scope and idempotency
reread the resolved canonical tracker immediately before update
update the existing tracker rather than creating a competitor
verify the tracker and report tracker ID, event IDs, and changed fields

belief_hygiene.maxim: Repetition is not confirmation, retrieval is not validation, and age alone does not make a belief knowledge.
belief_hygiene.decay_rule: decay present applicability or priming, never rewrite historical confidence

enforcement.mode: instruction plus observable read-only bootstrap plus evaluation
enforcement.enable_blocking_only_after: Repeated compliance evaluations show instruction and bootstrap adoption are insufficient, followed by explicit operator authorization.
